AlphaEngine.description:
L6 output: alpha signal under bounded uncertainty.

Alpha = Σ(Driver × Weight × Regime Multiplier × Mispricing Factor)

Constraints:
- Alpha cannot override driver structure
- Alpha must reference regime state
- Alpha must include scenario uncertainty

mispricing.description: The specific gap between consensus and structure
mispricing.title: Mispricing

alpha_signal.description: Bounded structural signal with conditions; never prescriptive investment advice
alpha_signal.title: Alpha Signal

falsifiers.description: Concrete falsifying conditions (min 1): observable events or data that would invalidate the structural view. Single-point chokepoints must appear here or in the failure cascade. These are graded against reality in the next run
falsifiers.title: Falsifiers

crowding_assessment.description: Whether the structural view ITSELF is already a crowded trade: cite positioning evidence (fund flows, futures positioning, short interest, sell-side alignment) or state what was checked
crowding_assessment.title: Crowding Assessment

irreversibility.description: Downside reversibility: none | partial | absorbing. `absorbing` means a plausible absorbing state exists (bankruptcy, delisting, nationalization, technology zeroing) where expected-value framing fails
irreversibility.title: Irreversibility

ruin_path.description: Required when irreversibility=absorbing: the concrete path to the absorbing state and what makes it non-recoverable
ruin_path.title: Ruin Path

reference_class.description: Outside view (forecasting science): the historical reference class this situation belongs to and the rough base rate of the claimed outcome inside that class — stated before the inside view
reference_class.title: Reference Class

prior_probability.description: Base-rate prior taken from reference_class before applying case-specific evidence
prior_probability.title: Prior Probability

evidence_adjustments.description: Cited, directional updates that move prior_probability toward the final confidence. Confidence not reachable from the prior through cited adjustments is confidence inflation
evidence_adjustments.title: Evidence Adjustments

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Source IDs supporting the alpha signal
supporting_evidence_ids.title: Supporting Evidence Ids

observed_price.description: Optional observed market price used by the signal
observed_price.title: Observed Price

price_as_of.description: Observation date for observed_price in YYYY-MM-DD
price_as_of.title: Price As Of

AlphaEngine.title: AlphaEngine

AssetMapping.description: An asset mapped to investment category with exposure metrics.

role.description: Variable role: SV_controller | FV_bottleneck | CV_beneficiary | LV_reflection
role.title: Role

sensitivity_to_drivers.description: Which L2 drivers this asset is most sensitive to
sensitivity_to_drivers.title: Sensitivity To Drivers

risk_profile.description: Risk profile — what could go wrong for this asset
risk_profile.title: Risk Profile

evidence_ids.description: Evidence IDs used to verify this asset mapping
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

AssetMapping.title: AssetMapping

CapacityLag.description: Capacity lag module — supply response delay.

capex_cycle_lag.description: Capital expenditure cycle lag in months (e.g., '18 months')
capex_cycle_lag.title: Capex Cycle Lag

supply_response_delay.description: Supply response delay: short | mid | long
supply_response_delay.title: Supply Response Delay

CapacityLag.title: CapacityLag

Chokepoint.description:
Network-science view of a flow: where is the topology concentrated?

A single-point chokepoint is a structural fragility and must be
reflected in the L0 failure cascade or the L6 falsifiers.

name.description: Chokepoint node (e.g., a rail corridor, sole fab, clearing house)
name.title: Name

flow_type.description: Which flow passes through it: capital | goods | information | risk | subsidy flow
flow_type.title: Flow Type

evidence_ids.description: Source IDs supporting the concentration assessment
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

Chokepoint.title: Chokepoint

elasticity.description: Demand elasticity magnitude — absolute value, sign dropped (0=inelastic/rigid, 1=highly elastic)
elasticity.title: Elasticity

state_dependency.description: Whether demand depends on system state (true=state-dependent, false=state-independent)
state_dependency.title: State Dependency

DistortionEngine.description:
L5 output: gap between market belief and structural reality.

Mispricing types: cycle | structural | liquidity | narrative | policy

market_belief.description: What the market currently believes about this system
market_belief.title: Market Belief

structural_truth.description: What the structural analysis actually reveals
structural_truth.title: Structural Truth

mispricing_sources.description: Specific sources of mispricing — where market belief diverges from reality
mispricing_sources.title: Mispricing Sources

persistence_mechanism.description: Limits-to-arbitrage explanation: who is on the wrong side of this mispricing and which concrete constraint (mandate, career risk, liquidity, position limits, information latency) prevents arbitrage from closing the gap. A mispricing without a persistence mechanism is only a disagreement with the market
persistence_mechanism.title: Persistence Mechanism

narrative_stage.description: Where the dominant narrative sits on the diffusion curve: emerging | spreading | saturated | fading
narrative_stage.title: Narrative Stage

narrative_stage_proxy.description: Measurable proxy justifying narrative_stage (media volume slope, search trend, coverage breadth), not an impression
narrative_stage_proxy.title: Narrative Stage Proxy

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Source IDs supporting the structural truth
supporting_evidence_ids.title: Supporting Evidence Ids

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Source IDs supporting consensus or falsifying structural truth
contradicting_evidence_ids.title: Contradicting Evidence Ids

DistortionEngine.title: DistortionEngine

Driver.description:
A quantified causal driver.

V2.2: MUST map to exactly one variable group (SV/FV/CV/LV).
Direction can be '+', '-', or 'nonlinear'.

category.description: Driver category: macro | micro | policy | behavioral | financial | structural
category.title: Category

maps_to_variable.description: Which variable group this driver maps to: SV | FV | CV | LV
maps_to_variable.title: Maps To Variable

proxy.description: Measurable proxy for observing this driver (an index, price, filing line item, or published statistic), not an impression
proxy.title: Proxy

elasticity.description: How sensitive the system is to this driver — magnitude/absolute value (0=inelastic, 1=highly elastic)
elasticity.title: Elasticity

volatility.description: How volatile/unpredictable this driver is (0=stable, 1=highly volatile)
volatility.title: Volatility

regime_dependency.description: How dependent on current regime this driver is (0=regime-independent, 1=fully regime-dependent)
regime_dependency.title: Regime Dependency

Driver.title: Driver

DriverSpace.description:
L2 output: fully quantified driver space.

Every driver MUST map to exactly one variable group.
No free-text drivers. No duplicate semantic drivers.

drivers.description: Quantified causal drivers — each must map to SV/FV/CV/LV
drivers.title: Drivers

covered_segment_ids.description: Exact SEG IDs represented by at least one driver
covered_segment_ids.title: Covered Segment Ids

covered_dimension_ids.description: Exact DIM IDs represented by at least one driver
covered_dimension_ids.title: Covered Dimension Ids

DriverSpace.title: DriverSpace

EarlyWarningSignal.description:
Critical-transition early warning (complex-systems science).

Systems approaching a tipping point show measurable precursors:
critical slowing down, rising variance, flickering between states.

signal.description: Signal type: critical_slowing | rising_variance | flickering | none_observed
signal.title: Signal

proxy.description: Measurable proxy examined (e.g., volatility decay after shocks, spread oscillation amplitude, policy stance flip-flops)
proxy.title: Proxy

EarlyWarningSignal.title: EarlyWarningSignal

EvidenceAdjustment.description: One evidence-grounded update applied to the prior (Bayesian audit trail).

evidence_id.description: Source ID of the evidence driving this update
evidence_id.title: Evidence Id

rationale.description: Why this evidence moves the prior, in one sentence
rationale.title: Rationale

EvidenceAdjustment.title: EvidenceAdjustment

FeedbackLoop.description:
A feedback loop in the system.

Control-theory rule: a balancing loop with a long delay is an
oscillation source (bullwhip/hog-cycle), not a stabilizer.

mechanism.description: How the loop works — the causal chain
mechanism.title: Mechanism

trigger.description: What triggers this loop to activate
trigger.title: Trigger

amplification_factor.description: Normalized amplification strength in [0, 1] — NOT a gain multiple (0=strong damping, 1=extreme amplification)
amplification_factor.title: Amplification Factor

delay.description: Loop delay: short | mid | long. A balancing loop with long delay must be treated as an oscillation risk, not a stabilizer
delay.title: Delay

FeedbackLoop.title: FeedbackLoop

FlowFeedbackSystem.description:
L3 output: flow types and feedback loops.

Minimum 3 feedback loops, including at least:
- 1 reinforcing loop
- 1 balancing loop

flow_types.description: Flow types present: capital flow, goods flow, information flow, risk flow, subsidy flow
flow_types.title: Flow Types

feedback_loops.description: Feedback loops in the system (min 3, ≥1 reinforcing + ≥1 balancing)
feedback_loops.title: Feedback Loops

chokepoints.description: Topological concentration assessment for the material flows (min 1). Use single_point only when one node's failure severs the flow; such nodes must reappear in the failure cascade or the L6 falsifiers
chokepoints.title: Chokepoints

FlowFeedbackSystem.title: FlowFeedbackSystem

InventoryCycle.description: Inventory cycle state — nonlinear price response driver.

cycle_stage.description: Current stage: early | mid | late | crash
cycle_stage.title: Cycle Stage

price_sensitivity.description: How sensitive price is to inventory changes (0=insensitive, 1=extreme sensitivity)
price_sensitivity.title: Price Sensitivity

InventoryCycle.title: InventoryCycle

best_positioned.description: Assets best positioned to profit from the identified alpha
best_positioned.title: Best Positioned

overvalued.description: Assets whose market value exceeds structural value
overvalued.title: Overvalued

fragile.description: Assets structurally fragile to regime shifts
fragile.title: Fragile

MetaSystemDefinition.description:
L0 output: meta system definition.

V2.2: simplified — variables moved to L1, feedback moved to L3.
Focus on: what the system IS, what BREAKS if it disappears.

system_type.description: Type of system (e.g., 'financial market', 'supply chain', 'platform economy')
system_type.title: System Type

core_function.description: The irreducible function this system performs
core_function.title: Core Function

system_boundary.description: What is INSIDE vs OUTSIDE the system — where does the system end?
system_boundary.title: System Boundary

failure_mode.description: How does this system break? What is the failure cascade?
failure_mode.title: Failure Mode

covered_segment_ids.description: Exact SEG IDs from the binding EntityProfile coverage contract
covered_segment_ids.title: Covered Segment Ids

covered_dimension_ids.description: Exact DIM IDs from the binding EntityProfile coverage contract
covered_dimension_ids.title: Covered Dimension Ids

MetaSystemDefinition.title: MetaSystemDefinition

NonlinearDynamics.description:
Nonlinear system dynamics — feeds into Regime Engine.

Price ≠ linear function of cost.
Price = f(inventory, leverage, sentiment, marginal_cost, liquidity)
NonlinearDynamics.title: NonlinearDynamics

RegimeEngine.description:
L4 output: nonlinear regime state.

Regime(t) = f(SV, FV, CV, LV, ΔDrivers)
Regime changes only if: Σ(Weighted Driver Shocks) > Threshold
Threshold = f(volatility, leverage, inventory level)

Bayesian discipline: a single next_regime point estimate is not
falsifiable. The full next-period distribution over all six regimes
(including staying in the current one) is required and must sum to 1.

current_regime.description: Current regime: expansion | contraction | transition | bubble | collapse | shock
current_regime.title: Current Regime

transition_probability.description: Most likely transition to a DIFFERENT regime; must equal the argmax of regime_distribution excluding current_regime

regime_distribution.description: Full next-period probability distribution over ALL six regimes (expansion, contraction, transition, bubble, collapse, shock), including remaining in current_regime. Values sum to 1.0. Avoid false precision: one decimal step of 0.05 is enough
regime_distribution.title: Regime Distribution

early_warning_signals.description: Critical-transition precursors examined (min 1). Report none_observed with the proxy that was checked rather than omitting the assessment; a large transition-away probability without any observed signal needs an explicit exogenous driver
early_warning_signals.title: Early Warning Signals

RegimeEngine.title: RegimeEngine

next_regime.description: Most likely next regime: expansion | contraction | transition | bubble | collapse | shock
next_regime.title: Next Regime

control_variables.description: CV: policy/pricing/constraint variables (interest rate, carbon tax, tariffs, regulation intensity)
control_variables.title: Control Variables

latent_variables.description: LV: unobservable state drivers (expectation, sentiment, narrative, risk appetite, uncertainty)
latent_variables.title: Latent Variables

covered_segment_ids.title: Covered Segment Ids

covered_dimension_ids.description: Exact DIM IDs from the binding EntityProfile coverage contract
covered_dimension_ids.title: Covered Dimension Ids
